note: Source validated against the official Kumon UK and Singapore curricula (2026). Maths: levels 7A to O plus the X specialty tracks (XV Vectors, XM Transformations, XP Permutations, XS Statistics). English: 18 main levels 7A to L, with sub levels AI/AII through GI/GII for levels A to G. H to L are single levels. The final English level is L.
warning: This roadmap is maintained by hand and can lag behind the real worksheet content. Check it against the current week before trusting it.
granularity: Levels A to D of maths are broken down by Kumon sheet set, because that is where both children are working. From Level E up, and for English above Level D, each level lists the published topics for that level rather than its sheet sets. Check a level with the centre before treating its breakdown as exact.
stateNote: A level is marked current when at least one sub-topic inside it is. More than one level can be current at once: the weekly homework runs nine slots in parallel, so multiplication and division can advance on different sheets. Every current sub-topic names the homework slot and rung that evidences it, from data/curriculum/position.json on 2026-10-11.
shapeNote: The two ladders below are the Kumon programme itself, so they are defined once and shared. A child record holds only where that child stands on them: every id in `cleared`, every id in `current` with the reason, and everything else is still ahead. That is deliberate. The two children were previously two hand kept copies of the same ladder, which is how a roadmap drifts.

items.name: 7A
items.detail: Counting up to 10, matching a number to a quantity, pencil control and tracing

items.name: 6A
items.detail: Counting up to 30, reading numbers, writing the numbers already recognised

items.name: 5A
items.detail: Writing numbers 1 to 50, number sequences up to 100

sections.label: Level 4A
sections.sub: Larger numbers and the first addition

items.name: 4A
items.detail: Reading and writing numbers up to 220, number sequences, the idea of adding on

items.name: 3A
items.detail: Mental addition +1, +2 and +3, horizontal, no written method

items.name: 2A
items.detail: Mental addition +4 to +10, adding 4 to 9 in sequence, sums up to 10

items.name: A1-8
items.detail: Addition 1 (review of 2A), addition 2-8, sums up to 12 then up to 28, with summary

items.name: A9-12
items.detail: Subtraction 1-4: subtracting 1, 2, 3, and up to 3, from numbers up to 10

items.name: A13-20
items.detail: Subtraction 5-12: from numbers up to 11 then up to 20, summary, Level A complete

items.name: B1-10
items.detail: Vertical 2 and 3-digit addition with carrying, and mental addition that bridges a ten

items.name: B11-20
items.detail: Vertical 2 and 3-digit subtraction with borrowing, first word problems, Level B complete

items.name: C1-4
items.detail: Multiplication tables x1-x3, x1-x5, x1-x7, x1-x9 (recall drills)

items.name: C5-10
items.detail: 2-digit x 1-digit (5 progressive sections), then 3 or 4-digit x 1-digit

items.name: C11
items.detail: Introduction to division, short division with no remainder

items.name: C12-15
items.detail: Division with remainders (4 sections)

items.name: C16-17
items.detail: Division: 2-digit divided by 1-digit (2 sections)

items.name: C18-20
items.detail: Division: 3-digit divided by 1-digit (2 sections), Level C complete

sections.label: Level D
sections.sub: 20 sub-topics, SCT 2-6 min per sheet. The three blocks below are the ones mapped to sheet sets so far.

items.name: D1-4
items.detail: 2-digit x 2-digit (3 sections), 3-digit x 2-digit

items.name: D5-8
items.detail: Mixed add and subtract, multiplication and division, division by 2-digit numbers (5 sections)

items.name: D9-12
items.detail: Division with quotients of 2 or more digits, introduction to fractions, reduction (4 sections, GCF)

items.name: Equivalent fractions
items.detail: Reduction to lowest terms, improper fractions and mixed numbers

items.name: Addition and subtraction
items.detail: Fractions with different denominators, using the lowest common multiple

items.name: Word problems
items.detail: Fraction word problems, and fractions of a quantity

sections.label: Level F
sections.sub: Fractions and decimals: all four operations

items.name: Multiplication and division
items.detail: Multiplying and dividing fractions and mixed numbers

items.name: Four operations
items.detail: Fractions and decimals together, converting between the two

items.name: Order of operations
items.detail: Brackets and the order of operations, then word problems

sections.label: Level G
sections.sub: Negative numbers and the first algebra

items.name: Positive and negative numbers
items.detail: The four operations with directed numbers

items.name: Algebraic expressions
items.detail: Simplifying, substituting and expanding simple expressions

items.name: Linear equations
items.detail: Equations in one variable, then word problems that lead to one

items.name: Simultaneous equations
items.detail: Linear equations in two variables, by substitution and elimination

items.name: Inequalities
items.detail: Solving and graphing linear inequalities

items.name: Functions and graphs
items.detail: Linear functions, gradient and intercept, graphing

items.name: Expansion and factorisation
items.detail: Expanding brackets, then factorising quadratic expressions

items.name: Square roots
items.detail: Surds and operations with square roots

items.name: Quadratic equations
items.detail: By factorising, completing the square and the formula

items.name: Pythagoras' theorem
items.detail: The theorem and its use in two dimensions

items.name: Polynomials
items.detail: Division of polynomials, the remainder and factor theorems

items.name: Fractional and irrational expressions
items.detail: Algebraic fractions and expressions with surds

items.name: Inequalities and proof
items.detail: Simultaneous and quadratic inequalities, and simple proofs

items.name: Quadratic functions
items.detail: Maximum and minimum values, and quadratic graphs

items.name: Fractional and irrational functions
items.detail: Their graphs and domains

items.name: Exponential and logarithmic functions
items.detail: Indices, logarithms and their graphs

sections.label: Level L
sections.sub: Limits and the start of calculus

items.name: Limits
items.detail: Limits of functions, and continuity

items.name: Differentiation
items.detail: From first principles, then the rules, tangents and rates of change

items.name: Integration
items.detail: Indefinite and definite integrals, area under a curve

items.name: Trigonometric functions
items.detail: The ratios, identities, and equations involving them

items.name: Straight lines and circles
items.detail: Coordinate geometry of lines, circles and their intersections

items.name: Loci and regions
items.detail: Describing a locus, and regions defined by inequalities

items.name: Sequences and series
items.detail: Arithmetic and geometric series, sigma notation, limits of sequences

items.name: Further differentiation
items.detail: Differentiating products, quotients and composite functions

sections.label: Level O
sections.sub: Advanced calculus, the final maths level

items.name: Advanced differentiation
items.detail: Implicit and parametric differentiation, curve sketching

items.name: Advanced integration
items.detail: Substitution, parts, and applications to area and volume

items.name: Differential equations
items.detail: Forming and solving them, with applications. Level O complete

sections.label: X levels
sections.sub: Electives, taken alongside or after Level O

items.name: XV Vectors
